title: Fix milestone checkbox interaction and ensure notes are always editable

requirements.summary: Make milestone header clickable to toggle completion checkbox
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking on the milestone header area toggles a checkbox for that milestone
The checkbox state visually reflects whether the milestone is completed or not
The milestone's completion state updates immediately when clicked
Progress bars and percentages update automatically when milestones are marked complete

file_operations.description: Add a clickable milestone header with an integrated checkbox that toggles milestone completion status. The entire header area (not just the expand/collapse icon) should be clickable. Add visual feedback showing completion state (e.g., checkmark icon, styling changes). Wire the checkbox state to track whether all tasks in the milestone are completed, and trigger progress recalculation when toggled. Ensure the expand/collapse functionality remains separate from the completion toggle.

requirements.summary: Display task notes as always-visible, always-editable textarea
acceptanceCriteria: Notes textarea is visible by default on every task card
Notes textarea is immediately editable without requiring any expand/collapse action
Changes to notes are saved to the backend when the user updates them
No expand/collapse icon or button appears near the notes section

file_operations.description: Remove any collapsible/expandable behavior from the notes section. Display the notes textarea as always visible and always editable directly on the TaskCard. Wire the textarea onChange handler to call the addTaskNotes method from useTasks hook to persist changes to the backend. Remove any expand/collapse icons or buttons associated with the notes field. Ensure the textarea has appropriate styling and placeholder text.

requirements.summary: Verify task checkbox correctly toggles completion status with backend persistence
acceptanceCriteria: Each task card displays a functional checkbox
Clicking the checkbox toggles the task's completed field in the backend
The checkbox visual state (checked/unchecked) accurately reflects the backend completion status

file_operations.description: Verify that the existing checkbox on TaskCard correctly calls the completeTask method from useTasks hook with the task ID and toggled boolean value (true for completed, false for not completed). Ensure the checkbox checked state is bound to task.completed field. Confirm that changes trigger a React Query cache invalidation to reflect updated state immediately. Add visual styling to distinguish completed vs. incomplete tasks (e.g., strikethrough text, opacity changes).

requirements.summary: Update progress calculations to use binary completed field
acceptanceCriteria: Progress calculations count only tasks with completed=true as complete
Progress calculations count tasks with completed=false as incomplete
Progress percentages update automatically when task completion states change
Phase progress indicators show accurate completion counts and percentages
Overall progress indicator shows accurate total project completion percentage

file_operations.description: Update all progress calculation functions (calculateMilestoneProgress, calculatePhaseProgress, calculateOverallProgress) to use the binary task.completed field (boolean true/false) instead of any status string fields. Count tasks where completed === true as complete, and tasks where completed === false as incomplete. Ensure calculations return accurate completion counts and percentages for milestones, phases, and overall project. Verify that progress calculations automatically reflect changes when task completion states are updated.

Verify that OverallProgress component correctly displays progress data from progressUtils calculations. Ensure the component re-renders automatically when task completion states change and progress calculations update. Confirm that the progress bar, percentage, and milestone counts accurately reflect the binary completed field.

Verify that PhaseNavigation component correctly displays phase-level progress using progressUtils calculations. Ensure progress bars and milestone completion counts update automatically when tasks are marked complete or incomplete. Confirm that the displayed progress accurately reflects the binary completed field.

Verify that MilestoneSection displays milestone-level progress using progressUtils calculations. Ensure the task progress indicators (e.g., '3/5 tasks completed') update automatically when task completion states change. Confirm that the progress bar accurately reflects completion based on the binary completed field.
